note: Rewritten from Sands' (1999) new species description, original in English; the genus lacks soldiers, only the worker has a complete description; measurements follow the original ranges.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: In most phenetic trees it groups with A. autothysius and A. gasteruptus at a slightly lower hierarchical level, and in the strict consensus tree it is connected to them at node 14. From A. mbalmayoensis it differs in that the latter is much larger, without conspicuous stout setae on the fore coxa, with the first marginal tooth of the left mandible nearly equilateral, the enteric valve ridges taper-ellipsoid with straight spines, and the valve six-radiate. From A. multispinus it differs in that the latter is slightly smaller, with the first marginal tooth of the left mandible nearly equilateral, more and longer primary-row spines on ridges one and three, longer than the narrowest point of ridge three, and a three-radiate valve. From A. spiculatus it differs in that the latter has distinctly longer legs, the first marginal tooth of the left mandible nearly equilateral, the fourth marginal tooth not touching the molar prominence, and the enteric valve ridges taper-ellipsoid rather than waisted, with varying degrees of sclerotization.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule, antennal flagellum, pronotum and legs yellowish white, abdominal tergites transparent. Head capsule short-oval, nearly circular or oval, setae sparse, projecting, the longest setae arranged regularly and symmetrically. Fontanelle absent. Anterior surface of the fore coxa with 4 or more stout setae arranged in rows or groups; fore tibia with 3 distal spurs, the third well developed, at least one-half the length of the others. Left mandible: anterior margin of the first marginal tooth distinctly longer than the posterior margin, anterior margin of the third marginal tooth as long as that of the first marginal tooth, the fourth marginal tooth just touching the lateral edge of the molar prominence in frontal view; right mandible: anterior margin of the first marginal tooth shorter than that of the second marginal tooth. Measurements: head width 0.614—0.713 mm; pronotum width 0.382—0.448 mm, length 0.175—0.22 mm; hind tibia length 0.637—0.736 mm; fore tibia length 0.499—0.571 mm; left mandible index 0.772—0.984, right mandible index 0.921—1.307.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The midgut–hindgut junction arises ventrally to the left of the nerve cord or below it; the first hindgut segment is rather short, up to 8 times as long as its proximal width, tubular throughout; in the undissected abdomen the enteric valve lies to the right of the heart (dorsal view) or to the left of the nerve cord (ventral view); the third lobe of the enteric valve seat is smaller than the outer pair. The enteric valve ridges are markedly waisted at the base of the apical spines and then widen, the ends sclerotized, pale brown or yellowish brown, bearing very long tapering spines: at most 10 on ridges one, two and four, 10—20 on ridge three; the longest curved but evenly tapering, not wider than the narrowest point of ridge three; because of the conspicuous differences in spine and ridge size, the valve is bilaterally symmetrical; the secondary rows bear conspicuous spines on one or more ridges.
